summary: Some users expressed strong enthusiasm for the Super Bowl, specifically looking forward to a matchup between the Baltimore Ravens and San Francisco 49ers. A different group of people indicated they did not care about the game or were uninterested in watching it. Tweets also included discussions about the halftime show, with many expressing excitement for performances by artists such as Beyoncé and Destiny's Child. Several users criticized the Super Bowl commercials, while others made jokes about food or halftime festivities. Many participants debated which teams would win the game and whether it was possible for two brothers to play against each other in the Super Bowl.
